basics.name: OrgName
basics.label: Organization Name
basics.toolTip: Name of the Company or Organization used for the Certificate Subject.

basics.name: license
basics.label: License Key
basics.toolTip: License Key for SCEPman. Leave as 'trial' for a trial license.

validations.message: Enter 'trial' or a valid SCEPman license key.

basics.name: updateChannel
basics.label: Update Channel
basics.toolTip: Select the update channel for SCEPman and Certificate Master. You can switch the channel after installation as well.

allowedValues.label: Production Channel
allowedValues.description: Use the latest stable version of SCEPman (recommended)

allowedValues.label: Beta Channel
allowedValues.description: Use the upcoming production release of SCEPman

allowedValues.label: Internal Channel
allowedValues.description: Use the SCEPman version currently under development (most features, but expect bugs)

elements.name: useExistingPlan
elements.label: App Service Plan
elements.toolTip: Create a new App Service Plan or use an existing one.

elements.name: appServicePlanName
elements.label: New App Service Plan Name
elements.toolTip: Name for the new App Service Plan. If left empty, a name with a unique string derived from the resource group is generated.

validations.message: Must be 1-40 characters, letters, numbers, and hyphens only.

elements.name: deployOnLinux
elements.label: Operating System
elements.toolTip: Choose the operating system for the new App Service Plan.

elements.name: appServicePlanSkuWindows
elements.label: Pricing Tier
elements.toolTip: Pricing tier of the new App Service Plan. You can scale the plan up or down after deployment.

elements.name: appServicePlanSkuLinux
elements.label: Pricing Tier
elements.toolTip: Pricing tier of the new App Service Plan. You can scale the plan up or down after deployment.

options.text: The pricing tier has a significant impact on cost and performance. Click here for the SCEPman App Service sizing recommendations.

elements.name: existingAppServicePlan
elements.label: Existing App Service Plan
elements.toolTip: Select an existing App Service Plan. Only plans in the subscription and region selected on the Basics tab are listed.

elements.name: primaryAppServiceName
elements.label: SCEPman App Service Name
elements.toolTip: Globally unique name for the SCEPman App Service. It is part of the default FQDN. If left empty, a name with a unique string derived from the resource group is generated.

validations.message: Must be 2-60 characters, contain only letters, numbers, and hyphens.

elements.name: certificateMasterAppServiceName
elements.label: Certificate Master App Service Name
elements.toolTip: Globally unique name for the Certificate Master App Service. It is part of the default FQDN. If left empty, a name with a unique string derived from the resource group is generated.

validations.message: Must be 2-60 characters, contain only letters, numbers, and hyphens.

elements.name: enableHealthCheck
elements.label: Enable App Service Health Check
elements.toolTip: Enable the App Service health check endpoint.

elements.name: useExistingKeyVault
elements.label: Key Vault
elements.toolTip: Create a new Key Vault or use an existing one.

elements.name: keyVaultName
elements.label: New Key Vault Name
elements.toolTip: Globally unique name for the Azure Key Vault. Only letters, numbers, and hyphens allowed. If left empty, a name with a unique string derived from the resource group is generated.

validations.message: Must be 3-24 characters, start with a letter, end with a letter or number, and contain only letters, numbers, and non-consecutive hyphens.

elements.name: existingKeyVault
elements.label: Existing Key Vault
elements.toolTip: Select an existing Key Vault from any resource group in the subscription selected on the Basics tab.

options.text: The Key Vault must use the Azure RBAC permission model. The SCEPman managed identity is assigned the roles Key Vault Crypto Officer, Key Vault Certificates Officer, and Key Vault Secrets User on it, so you need permissions to assign roles on the Key Vault. No private endpoint is created for an existing Key Vault, so make sure SCEPman can reach it. The key type RSA-HSM requires the Premium tier.

elements.name: caKeyType
elements.label: CA Key Type
elements.toolTip: Type of key pair for the SCEPman CA certificate.

elements.name: caSubjectMode
elements.label: CA Certificate Subject
elements.toolTip: Subject of the SCEPman root CA certificate. It cannot be changed after the CA certificate has been created.

elements.name: caSubject
elements.label: Custom CA Certificate Subject
elements.toolTip: Distinguished name of the SCEPman root CA certificate. It cannot be changed after the CA certificate has been created.

validations.message: Must be a distinguished name with up to 512 characters that contains a common name (CN=...).

elements.name: useExistingStorage
elements.label: Storage Account
elements.toolTip: Create a new Storage Account or use an existing one.

elements.name: storageAccountName
elements.label: New Storage Account Name
elements.toolTip: Globally unique name. 3-24 characters, lowercase letters and numbers only. If left empty, a name with a unique string derived from the resource group is generated.

validations.message: Must be 3-24 characters, lowercase letters and numbers only.

elements.name: existingStorageAccount
elements.label: Existing Storage Account
elements.toolTip: Select an existing Storage Account from any resource group in the subscription selected on the Basics tab.

options.text: The Storage Account must support Table storage, i.e. a Standard general-purpose v2 account (Premium accounts are not supported). The managed identities of SCEPman and Certificate Master are assigned the role Storage Table Data Contributor on the Storage Account, so you need permissions to assign roles on it. No private endpoint is created for an existing Storage Account, so make sure SCEPman and Certificate Master can reach its table service.

elements.name: logAnalyticsWorkspaceName
elements.label: Log Analytics Workspace Name
elements.toolTip: Name for the new Log Analytics Workspace. 4-63 characters, alphanumerics and hyphens. If left empty, a name with a unique string derived from the resource group is generated.

validations.message: Must be 4-63 characters, alphanumerics and hyphens only.

elements.name: deployPrivateNetwork
elements.label: Deploy with Private Network
elements.toolTip: Deploy SCEPman with a Virtual Network. Private Endpoints are only created for a new Key Vault and a new Storage Account.

elements.name: virtualNetworkName
elements.label: Virtual Network Name
elements.toolTip: Name of the Virtual Network that the App Services are connected to. If left empty, a name with a unique string derived from the resource group is generated.

elements.name: nsgName
elements.label: Network Security Group Name
elements.toolTip: Name of the Network Security Group applied to the subnets. If left empty, a name with a unique string derived from the resource group is generated.

elements.name: privateEndpointForKeyVaultName
elements.label: Key Vault Private Endpoint Name
elements.toolTip: Name of the Private Endpoint for the new Key Vault. If left empty, a name with a unique string derived from the resource group is generated.

elements.name: privateEndpointForTableStorage
elements.label: Table Storage Private Endpoint Name
elements.toolTip: Name of the Private Endpoint for the table service of the new Storage Account. If left empty, a name with a unique string derived from the resource group is generated.
